flowVariables.name: SPACE
flowVariables.instruction: Jira project key containing agreement issues. Only issues in this project are sent to PandaDoc.

flowVariables.name: PANDADOC_BASE_URL
flowVariables.instruction: PandaDoc API host for the target account or environment.

flowVariables.name: PANDADOC_CREATE_SIGNATURE_PATH
flowVariables.instruction: PandaDoc API path that creates and sends a signature request from a template. Adjust the request body and response id JSONPath if your endpoint differs.

flowVariables.name: PANDADOC_TEMPLATE_ID
flowVariables.instruction: PandaDoc template ID used to create the agreement signature request.

flowVariables.name: PANDADOC_SIGNER_ROLE_NAME
flowVariables.instruction: PandaDoc signer role name used by the configured template, if supported by the provider.

flowVariables.name: PANDADOC_WEBHOOK_URL
flowVariables.instruction: Paste the trigger URL from the PandaDoc Incoming Status flow after it is created.
